products.name: Barrel Sample Register
products.product: A focused craft distillery barrel sample and decision tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent craft distilleries with tasting-room and wholesale operations
products.problem: Barrel identity, sample date, sensory notes, laboratory results, blend candidates, holds, and next-review decisions are distributed across notebooks.
products.valueProposition: Turns craft distillery barrel sample and decision tracking into a visible operating queue so every sampled barrel has traceable evidence, an authorized disposition, and a next review or production action.
products.topic: craft distillery barrel sample and decision tracking
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
